newsitem.title: TAIWAN: First Bank to cut deposit rates further.
newsitem.headline: First Bank to cut deposit rates further.

text.p: First Bank, one of Taiwan's big three state commercial banks, announced on Wednesday it was lowering further its time deposit rates, effective on Thursday.
The bank was cutting its one-year to three-year time deposits by between 0.10 and 0.15 percentage points, a bank statement said.
All big three banks cut their prime lending rates and various deposit rates in the past five days.
Taiwan's Central Bank Governor Sheu Yuan-dong said on Sunday the bank would not interfere with local banks' decision to lower interest rates.
